Package org.tmt.aps.peas.common.cdi Description

CDI (Component Dependency Injection) related classes that define annotations specific to PEAS-PCS.

The currently defined annotations enable methods to collaborate with Abort requests, and enable computations to be annotated so that their output data is collected automatically
